sources.role: Canonical rich logo: smoky glass sphere of molten ivory and amber, coarse obsidian in a polished crescent, five obsidian crown prisms. README hero.
Canonical Quiet Orbit motion reference. Review media only; not shipped in the native app.
Small-size vector family: one crescent, one disc, five triangles.
Header and favicon-size mark. Used wherever the rich logo would not stay legible.
Historical static banner. No active consumer in the native app; superseded by the material logo.

startup.reduced_motion: one complete still, same timing, no crossfade

runtime.note: The native splash draws the scene from vector geometry. No raster layer pack is shipped; the GIF and PNG stay repository references.
